verdict.rationale: Gmail's built-in Gemini assistant takes delegated tasks. First-party docs say users can ask it to delete multiple emails or add labels, draft and refine emails, summarize threads, and propose meeting times from Google Calendar. Community reports confirm the AI features are real and in use, but one user saw a summary hallucinate a delivery date, and some features require opting in to Smart Features across Workspace. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the full range and limits of actions Gemini can take, independent hands-on corroboration of task delegation (as opposed to summaries and writing suggestions), and evidence of reliability or accuracy safeguards.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Organize: Ask Gemini to do things like delete multiple emails or add labels.
Summarize: Synthesize long email threads into concise bullet points. Draft: Create new emails or refine existing drafts for tone and clarity.
Schedule: Propose meeting times based on your availability in Google Calendar.
Gemini in Gmail saves you time drafting or polishing emails
